_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
A delegated question reaches the chat, and its reply reaches Live. The voice call is faked. In an eval, window.liveEmit(event) delivers event from Live (e.g. window.liveEmit({type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: "Hello ", start_ms: 0, end_ms: 400})); emit each event in its own eval, in the order given. window.liveSpeak(id, speech) speaks and delegates: it emits {type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: speech, start_ms: 0, end_ms: 900} and then {type: "session.delegation.created", offset_ms: 900, delegation: {id, target: "client"}}. window.liveNotes() returns the JSON of everything Shelley sent to Live. window.__voiceTracksStopped counts the microphone tracks stopped. "Start the call" means: click data-testid "live-call-header"; data-testid "live-bar" should contain "On call". "The exchange" is data-testid "live-exchange". "The message X" is the [data-testid="message"] elements whose text contains X (has_text; it collapses whitespace, so a line break is a space). Text checks on messages and the exchange compare whitespace-collapsed text: eval el.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, " ").includes(...) with expect true (or false for "not contain"), on every matching element. Call "sessions" describes the call starts (POST /api/conversation/<id>/live-session) as JSON; call "relayed session.started" says whether any event of type "session.started" was relayed to the server. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/ready. data-testid "live-call-header" should have aria-label exactly "Start voice conversation".
2. Click it. data-testid "live-bar" should contain "On call"; the header button's aria-label should become exactly "End voice call", and its computed color should equal the computed backgroundColor of data-testid "live-stop" (eval the comparison, expect true). data-testid "live-timer" should be visible.
3. The strip sits by the composer, with a wide meter and no captions: the live bar's getBoundingClientRect().y should be >= that of ".message-input-container" (eval, expect true); data-testid "live-meter" should be at least 110px wide (eval, expect true); there should be no data-testid "live-transcript" (count 0).
4. Emit, in order: {type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: "Hello ", start_ms: 0, end_ms: 400}; {type: "session.output_transcript.delta", delta: "Hey there!", start_ms: 500, end_ms: 900}; {type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: "echo: why is this so slow", start_ms: 1200, end_ms: 1900}; {type: "session.started"} (Shelley doesn't need it); and then twice, as Live may repeat an event, {type: "session.delegation.created", offset_ms: 1900, delegation: {id: "captured_question", target: "client"}}.
5. There should be exactly one message "Spoken request: Hello echo: why is this so slow", and it should contain "Call #1 Voice Exchange [Captions 1-3] (for context only): USER: Hello LIVE: Hey there! USER: echo: why is this so slow".
6. Call "sessions" should return exactly {"count":1,"conversation_options":false}, and call "relayed session.started" exactly "false".
7. window.liveNotes() should come to include "The backend accepted this task: Hello echo: why is this so slow", and also '"delegation_id":"captured_question","content":"Backend reply: edit predictable.go' (eval includes, expect true).
8. Click the header button again. The live bar should become hidden, and the header button's aria-label exactly "Start voice conversation". window.liveNotes() should include "session.close", window.__voiceTracksStopped should be exactly 1, and there should still be exactly one message "Spoken request: Hello echo: why is this so slow".
